headline: Weathered Expanse Margin Narrows as Stonecradle Erupts Anew
war_summary: Since our last edition the Weathered Expanse has swung back toward even terms, the Wardens reclaiming one work to stand five against four, with Frostmarch the busiest post on that front and the day's heaviest toll — better than 9,900 Colonial and 12,300 Warden casualties in twenty-four hours — still mounting. Stonecradle, long silent, has erupted anew with five flag actions inside two hours about The Heir's Knife and World's End, the count holding at five Colonial to four Warden. Stlican Shelf remains in play, Fort Hoarfrost its storm center, and in the Dead Lands the flag at Callahan's Gate went to Warden hands minutes before this edition closed, one Warden work now standing among eleven as losses there accelerate sharply. The ledger now reads 298 Colonial works to 138 Warden, none in ruin, a net gain of eleven to the Colonial roll since our last accounting. Godcrofts, the busiest map by the day's accounts, has fallen quiet these two hours with all nine works under Colonial colors, and the Linn of Mercy cools likewise. Callahan's Passage remains the costliest field, its latest hour alone costing nearly 1,300 Colonial and some 680 Warden. Day 242; no victor declared.
